# Hybrid_ANN_SNN_Pipeline

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A processing architecture that interleaves artificial neural network (ANN) layers with spiking neural network (SNN) layers to combine dense feature extraction with event-driven temporal processing. Enables efficient deployment of deep learning features on neuromorphic hardware while retaining spike-based energy and temporal advantages.
